help_menu: Click the buttons below to get information about my commands. Note: All commands can be used with /
help_admins: Admin commands: /pause: Pause the ongoing stream. /resume: Resume the paused stream. /skip: Skip the current stream. /stop: Stop the ongoing stream. /seek [seconds]: Seek the ongoing stream forward. /seekback [seconds]: Seek the ongoing stream backward. /loop [1-20|all|off]: Loop the current song a number of times, loop the whole queue with all, or stop looping. /playmode: View group playback settings. Only the current Telegram group owner can change the playback policy with /playmode admins or /playmode everyone; admins may view it but cannot change it. /autoplay [on|off]: When the queue ends, keep playing similar songs automatically (admins, sudo and /auth users can change it). /reload: Reloads the admin cache.
help_auth: Auth commands: Authorized users can control the ongoing stream without being an admin. /auth: Add a user to the authorized users list. /unauth: Remove a user from the authorized users list. /authlist: Show the authorized users in this chat.
help_blist: Blacklist commands: Blacklisted chats and users cannot use the bot. /blacklist [chat_id|user_id]: Add a chat/user to the blacklist. /unblacklist [chat_id|user_id]: Remove a chat/user from the blacklist
help_lang: Language commands: This bot supports multiple languages. /lang: Change the language of the bot.
help_ping: Ping commands: /help: Shows the help menu of the bot. /ping: Check the ping and memory usage of the bot. /start: Start the bot.
help_play: Play commands: You can play music in the video chat using the following commands. /play [song name/youtube url/reply to audio]: Play music in the video chat (everyone may use it by default). /vplay [song name/youtube url/reply to video]: Play music video in the video chat. /song [song name]: Download the song as an audio file. /speed [0.5-2.0]: Change the playback speed. /playing: Show the current track. YouTube live links and direct stream (m3u8) links are supported — /play for audio, /vplay for audio + video. /playforce, /vplayforce: Skip the current song and play immediately. In the strict Admins only policy, only a live group administrator/creator may start playback; auth users, sudo users, and force-all settings do not bypass it. Outside that policy, the existing Force play setting controls this command. /playmode admins|everyone: View or change playback policy (only the current group owner can change it). -f: Force play music in the video chat. -v: Plays music video in the video chat. Example: /play -f -v attention Voice-overs and character dubs have their own section: Voice.
help_queue: Queue commands: /queue: Shows the currently queued tracks in the queue. /shuffle: Shuffle the upcoming tracks. /export: Export the queue as a file. /import: Import an exported queue (reply to the file).
help_sudo: Sudo commands: /ac: Shows the active calls count. /activevc: Shows the list of the active calls. /broadcast [reply to message]: Broadcasts the message to all the chats. -nochat: Excludes groups from the broadcast. -user: Include users in the broadcast. -copy: Removes the forwarded tag from the broadcast message. Example: /broadcast -user -copy /eval: Executes the given code. /logs: Sends the log file. /logger [on|off]: Enables/disables the logger. /restart: Restarts the bot. /addsudo: Add a user to the sudo users list. /rmsudo: Remove a user from the sudo users list.
help_voice: Voice commands: Every voice feature has two forms — text (you type it) and audio (you record it). /voiceover [text]: Pick a voice and the bot speaks your text — narrators (Neerja, Prabhat, Aria, Ryan…), character dubs with scene music (legend, romantic hero, action hero, South action, crime-serial cast), sung styles (bhajan, sad song, sufi qawwali) and the saved 🎤 voices. Replying to a text message works too. /voiceovertext is the same command. /voiceoveraudio: Send your own recording with the command as its caption (or reply to it with the command) and pick a voice — it comes back with your words in that voice. Sent alone, the bot asks for the recording (here or in its DM). Every generated clip is marked 🤖 AI-generated. Members get short clips, one at a time, with a cooldown.
help_clone: Clone voice commands: Use a real person's voice — from a voice note in the chat, or from the saved 🎤 voices. /clonevoicetext [text]: Reply to a member's voice note — the bot reads your text in that voice. Without a voice note it offers the saved 🎤 voices. /clonevoiceaudio: Reply to the voice note, then send your own recording (here or in the bot's DM) — your words come back in that voice. Saving voices (owner & sudo only) — send a voice note or audio file (6 sec to 5 min, 20–30 sec is best) with the command as its caption, or reply to it with: /clonevoice [text]: Hear the text in that voice once; nothing is saved. /clonevoice: Save it as a 🎤 button in /voiceover for everyone. /addvoice [Name]: Save it as another voice — a new 🎤 button (someone else's voice, with their permission; up to 4 voices per user). /clonevoice add: One more recording of a voice you already saved (steadier clips). /clonevoice name [Label]: What the button says. /clonevoice check [on|off]: AI word check on every clip of your voice. /clonevoice list: Your saved voices. /clonevoice delete [Name]: Remove a voice. Members: text up to 250 characters, one clip per 90 sec. Forwarded recordings and music files don't work.
help_owner: Owner commands: For the bot owner; /accounts also for sudo users. /owner: The control panel in private chat — assistants, stats, sudoers, broadcast, admin groups, logger. /accounts: Add or remove assistant accounts (the accounts that join the video chat). /clean: Delete leftover playback files, thumbnails and buffered songs, and show what the bot keeps (also for sudo users). /restrict [reply|@user|id]: Block a user from every function of this bot and of the group-help bot. /unrestrict [reply|@user|id]: Lift the restriction. /restricted: Show the restricted users.
